# TASK-088 — specification

## Scope

Real Ollama integration: context window read from `/api/show` and requested with `num_ctx` (`ollama.ts`); structured output through a grammar-safe JSON schema; a compact context for small windows focused on the sections a request names (title, single title word or question id) or on the most open questions (`local-context.ts`); a bounded local answer format converted to a proposal; model output cleaned of echoed answers, unknown question ids and downgrades of recorded answers; readable Ollama errors and an answer-length error; longer timeout for local runs; admin connection check (`GET /api/v1/integrations/ollama/status`, `OllamaStatus` panel in Administration); `pnpm ollama:check`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Connect to the real Ollama and test it: window-aware requests, a compact context for small models, structured output, safe cleaning of model answers, an admin connection check and a live check script.

## Verification

- tests/ollama.test.ts
- jobs.test.ts
- ollama.test.tsx

## Notes

Checked against the real Ollama 0.33.3 with `gemma2:2b` and `nomic-embed-text`: the check script's proposal applies, embeddings return 768 dimensions, and a job through the containerised worker completes in compact mode (70 s, focus on the named section). `tests/ollama.test.ts` (17), `jobs.test.ts`, `ollama.test.tsx`, stories.
